cond_0001.intro:
Data Scientists support business growth by using business intelligence software, advanced data mining techniques, and statistical analysis methodology to automate complex processes, visualize large data sets, and generate new insights. Data scientists are highly analytical, technically skilled, and have a passion for sharing their insights to a broad audience.
The Data Scientist position within the [Company name masked] Aftermarket Analytics team in Customer Service is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing solutions that support strategic initiatives by generating actionable insights and recommendations based on the latest data science methodologies. This role will have a focus on forecasting aircraft maintenance to assist with annual operational planning, discounting strategy, creating long term maintenance agreements, and ensuring we keep our service centers full.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Build, optimize, and automate data models to support business reporting and ad-hoc analysis
Advise leadership on analytical, data-driven approaches to solve challenges and identify opportunities
Develop statistical and machine learning models to answer business questions and make predictions using R, Python, and other programming languages
Experiment and explore new technologies to support business objectives
Monitor data models for accuracy and performance and update as needed to maintain quality
Develop best practices and document proven solutions
Interface with other data professionals throughout the organization to embrace cross functional growth in analytics capabilities
Provide guidance to data analysts to support expanding descriptive models into a predictive or prescriptive environment
Conduct training on data literacy and data science capabilities to data consumers
Gather and document analytics project requirements from business stakeholders, identifying opportunities to apply advanced analytic approaches
Explore and understand the inner workings and market context of an aircraft OEM
Preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment.
Solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques
Evaluate and optimize the performance of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or Computer Science plus 2 years relevant technical experience, or bachelor's degree in other related field plus 4 years relevant technical experience
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience with Microsoft Office including Excel and PowerPoint
Practical application experience with one or more analytics packages such as SAS, R, SQL, Python (& associated libraries), or similar
Experience working with relational databases, APIs, and ML production environments
Advanced analytics skills, including statistical characterization of large sets, regression modeling, probability distribution fitting, stochastic simulation, and multivariate sensitivity analysis
Ability to identify relevant metrics and explain technical information to a broad audience
Desire and ability to learn and leverage new software, tools, and processes in a self-learning environment
Demonstrated ability to clean and prepare data using techniques such as compression, binning, normalization/scaling, and 1-hot encoding within a pure code environment (Notebook or IDE)
Advanced matrix, multidimensional array, and table operations in pure coding environment
Preferred Requirements
Aviation experience
Demonstrated ability to preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment, including decision tree analysis, boosting, or Principal Component Analysis
Technical ability to solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques including SVM, logistic regression, and clustering
Basic understanding of time-series data analysis and prediction modeling (ARIMA, SARIMA, exponential smoothing) or otherwise
Technical ability to evaluate (i.e., F1 Score, Confusion Matrices, RMSE, etc.) and optimize the performance (i.e., grid search, hyperparameter tuning) of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
Basic understanding of Neural Networks with the ability to train a basic multi-layer perceptron in a pure code environment utilizing activation functions like ReLU, Sigmoid, etc.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

The Data Scientist position within the [Company name masked] Aftermarket Analytics team in Customer Service is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing solutions that support strategic initiatives by generating actionable insights and recommendations based on the latest data science methodologies. This role will have a focus on forecasting aircraft maintenance to assist with annual operational planning, discounting strategy, creating long term maintenance agreements, and ensuring we keep our service centers full.
A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with business stakeholders, data professionals, and data consumers across the organization to share findings and move analytical work forward.
cond_0060.responsibilities:
Build, optimize, and automate data models to support business reporting and ad-hoc analysis
Actively advise leadership on analytical, data-driven approaches to solve challenges and identify opportunities
Develop statistical and machine learning models to answer business questions and make predictions using R, Python, and other programming languages
Experiment and explore new technologies to support business objectives
Monitor data models for accuracy and performance and update as needed to maintain quality
Develop best practices and document proven solutions
Connect regularly with other data professionals throughout the organization to embrace cross functional growth in analytics capabilities
Provide guidance to data analysts to support expanding descriptive models into a predictive or prescriptive environment
Conduct training on data literacy and data science capabilities to data consumers
Gather and document analytics project requirements from business stakeholders, initiating discussions to clarify needs and identify opportunities to apply advanced analytic approaches
Explore and understand the inner workings and market context of an aircraft OEM
Preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment
Solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques
Evaluate and optimize the performance of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
cond_0060.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or Computer Science plus 2 years relevant technical experience, or bachelor's degree in a related field plus 4 years relevant technical experience
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information clearly to a broad audience
Practical application experience with one or more analytics packages such as SAS, R, SQL, Python (and associated libraries), or similar
Experience working with relational databases, APIs, and ML production environments
Advanced analytics skills, including statistical characterization of large sets, regression modeling, probability distribution fitting, stochastic simulation, and multivariate sensitivity analysis
Demonstrated ability to clean and prepare data using techniques such as compression, binning, normalization/scaling, and 1-hot encoding within a pure code environment (Notebook or IDE)
Advanced matrix, multidimensional array, and table operations in pure coding environment
Demonstrated ability to preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reduction algorithms within a pure code environment, including decision tree analysis, boosting, or Principal Component Analysis
Technical ability to solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques including SVM, logistic regression, and clustering
Technical ability to evaluate (e.g., F1 Score, Confusion Matrices, RMSE) and optimize the performance (e.g., grid search, hyperparameter tuning) of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
Preferred Requirements
Aviation experience
Experience with Microsoft Office including Excel and PowerPoint
Ability to identify relevant metrics and walk stakeholders through technical findings comfortably
Desire and ability to learn and leverage new software, tools, and processes in a self-learning environment
Basic understanding of time-series data analysis and prediction modeling (ARIMA, SARIMA, exponential smoothing) or similar
Basic understanding of Neural Networks with the ability to train a basic multi-layer perceptron in a pure code environment utilizing activation functions like ReLU, Sigmoid, etc.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

cond_0116.intro:
Data Scientists support business growth by using business intelligence software, advanced data mining techniques, and statistical analysis methodology to automate complex processes, visualize large data sets, and generate new insights.
The Data Scientist position within the [Company name masked] Aftermarket Analytics team in Customer Service is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing solutions that support strategic initiatives by generating actionable insights and recommendations based on the latest data science methodologies. This role will own forecasting aircraft maintenance to drive annual operational planning, discounting strategy, creating long term maintenance agreements, and ensuring service centers remain full.
cond_0116.responsibilities:
Build, optimize, and automate data models to drive business reporting and ad-hoc analysis
Lead leadership on analytical, data-driven approaches to solve challenges and identify opportunities
Develop statistical and machine learning models to answer business questions and make predictions using R, Python, and other programming languages
Direct exploration of new technologies to support business objectives
Own monitoring of data models for accuracy and performance and update as needed to maintain quality
Develop best practices and document proven solutions
Lead engagement with other data professionals throughout the organization to drive cross functional growth in analytics capabilities
Guide data analysts to expand descriptive models into a predictive or prescriptive environment
Deliver training on data literacy and data science capabilities to data consumers
Own gathering and documenting analytics project requirements from business stakeholders, identifying opportunities to apply advanced analytic approaches
Explore and determine the inner workings and market context of an aircraft OEM
Execute data preprocessing using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment
Solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques
Evaluate and optimize the performance of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
cond_0116.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or Computer Science plus 2 years relevant technical experience, or bachelor's degree in a related field plus 4 years relevant technical experience
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Practical application experience with one or more analytics packages such as SAS, R, SQL, Python (& associated libraries), or similar
Experience working with relational databases, APIs, and ML production environments
Advanced analytics skills, including statistical characterization of large sets, regression modeling, probability distribution fitting, stochastic simulation, and multivariate sensitivity analysis
Ability to identify relevant metrics and explain technical information to a broad audience
Demonstrated ability to clean and prepare data using techniques such as compression, binning, normalization/scaling, and 1-hot encoding within a pure code environment (Notebook or IDE)
Advanced matrix, multidimensional array, and table operations in pure coding environment
Demonstrated ability to preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment, including decision tree analysis, boosting, or Principal Component Analysis
Technical ability to solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques including SVM, logistic regression, and clustering
Technical ability to evaluate (i.e., F1 Score, Confusion Matrices, RMSE, etc.) and optimize the performance (i.e., grid search, hyperparameter tuning) of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
Preferred Requirements
Aviation experience
Experience with Microsoft Office including Excel and PowerPoint
Desire and ability to learn and leverage new software, tools, and processes in a self-learning environment
Basic understanding of time-series data analysis and prediction modeling (ARIMA, SARIMA, exponential smoothing) or otherwise
Basic understanding of Neural Networks with the ability to train a basic multi-layer perceptron in a pure code environment utilizing activation functions like ReLU, Sigmoid, etc.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

Data scientists are highly analytical, technically skilled, and have a passion for sharing their insights to a broad audience.
The Data Scientist position within the [Company name masked] Aftermarket Analytics team in Customer Service is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing solutions that support strategic initiatives by generating actionable insights and recommendations based on the latest data science methodologies. This role will have a focus on forecasting aircraft maintenance to assist with annual operational planning, discounting strategy, creating long term maintenance agreements, and ensuring we keep our service centers full.
cond_0155.responsibilities:
Build, optimize, and automate data models to support business reporting and ad-hoc analysis
Advise leadership on analytical, data-driven approaches to solve challenges and identify opportunities
Develop statistical and machine learning models to answer business questions and make predictions using R, Python, and other programming languages
Experiment and explore new technologies to support business objectives
Monitor data models for accuracy and performance and update as needed to maintain quality
Develop best practices and document proven solutions
Interface with other data professionals throughout the organization to embrace cross functional growth in analytics capabilities

Gather and document analytics project requirements from business stakeholders, identifying opportunities to apply advanced analytic approaches
Explore and understand the inner workings and market context of an aircraft OEM
Preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment.
Solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques
Evaluate and optimize the performance of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
cond_0155.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or Computer Science required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum 4 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant technical field for candidates with degrees in related fields, or minimum 2 years for candidates with a directly applicable degree.
Aviation experience preferred.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly to a broad audience.
Deep knowledge of Microsoft Office including Excel and PowerPoint.
Proven expertise in one or more analytics packages such as SAS, R, SQL, Python (and associated libraries), or similar.
Substantial experience working with relational databases, APIs, and ML production environments.
Advanced analytics expertise, including statistical characterization of large datasets, regression modeling, probability distribution fitting, stochastic simulation, and multivariate sensitivity analysis.
Demonstrated ability to identify relevant metrics and communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong command of self-directed learning, with a proven track record of adopting and leveraging new software, tools, and processes independently.
Demonstrated expertise in cleaning and preparing data using techniques such as compression, binning, normalization/scaling, and 1-hot encoding within a pure code environment (Notebook or IDE).
Advanced mastery of matrix, multidimensional array, and table operations in a pure coding environment.
Deep knowledge of preprocessing data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reduction algorithms within a pure code environment, including decision tree analysis, boosting, and Principal Component Analysis.
Strong command of regression and classification problem-solving using established machine learning techniques including SVM, logistic regression, and clustering.
Solid understanding of time-series data analysis and prediction modeling (ARIMA, SARIMA, exponential smoothing) or equivalent approaches.
Proven expertise in evaluating (F1 Score, Confusion Matrices, RMSE, etc.) and optimizing the performance (grid search, hyperparameter tuning) of machine learning models through results-based training and testing.
Solid understanding of Neural Networks, with demonstrated ability to train a multi-layer perceptron in a pure code environment utilizing activation functions such as ReLU, Sigmoid, etc.

Data Scientists support business growth by using business intelligence software, advanced data mining techniques, and statistical analysis methodology to automate complex processes, visualize large data sets, and generate new insights. Data scientists are highly analytical, technically skilled, and communicate their insights regularly to a broad audience.
The Data Scientist position within the [Company name masked] Aftermarket Analytics team in Customer Service is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing solutions that support strategic initiatives by generating actionable insights and recommendations based on the latest data science methodologies. A large part of this role involves staying in close contact with business stakeholders to focus on forecasting aircraft maintenance, assist with annual operational planning, discounting strategy, creating long term maintenance agreements, and ensuring service centers stay full.
cond_0195.responsibilities:
Build, optimize, and automate data models to support business reporting and ad-hoc analysis
Actively advise leadership on analytical, data-driven approaches to solve challenges and identify opportunities
Develop statistical and machine learning models to answer business questions and make predictions using R, Python, and other programming languages
Experiment and explore new technologies to support business objectives
Monitor data models for accuracy and performance and update as needed to maintain quality
Develop best practices and document proven solutions
Connect regularly with other data professionals throughout the organization to embrace cross functional growth in analytics capabilities
Provide guidance to data analysts to support expanding descriptive models into a predictive or prescriptive environment
Conduct training on data literacy and data science capabilities to data consumers, explaining concepts clearly and handling questions from a broad audience
Gather and document analytics project requirements from business stakeholders, initiating discussions to identify opportunities to apply advanced analytic approaches
Explore and understand the inner workings and market context of an aircraft OEM
Preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment
Solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques
Evaluate and optimize the performance of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
cond_0195.requirements:
Bachelor's degree required in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science plus 2 years relevant technical experience or bachelor's degree in other related field plus 4 years relevant technical experience
Aviation experience preferred
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience with Microsoft Office including Excel and PowerPoint
Practical application experience with one or more analytics packages such as SAS, R, SQL, Python (& associated libraries), or similar
Experience working with relational databases, APIs, and ML production environments
Advanced analytics skills, including statistical characterization of large sets, regression modeling, probability distribution fitting, stochastic simulation, and multivariate sensitivity analysis
Ability to identify relevant metrics and explain technical information to a broad audience
Desire and ability to learn and leverage new software, tools, and processes in a self-learning environment
Demonstrated aptitude to clean and prepare data using techniques such as compression, binning, normalization/scaling, and 1-hot encoding within a pure code environment (Notebook or IDE)
Advanced matrix, multidimensional array, and table operations in pure coding environment
Demonstrated ability to preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment. This may include decision tree analysis, boosting, or Principal Component Analysis
Technical ability to solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques including SVM, logistic regression, and clustering
Basic understanding of time-series data analysis and prediction modeling (ARIMA, SARIMA, exponential smoothing) or otherwise
Technical ability to evaluate (i.e., F1 Score, Confusion Matrices, RMSE, etc.) and optimize the performance (i.e., grid search, hyperparameter tuning) of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
Basic understanding of Neural Networks with the ability to train a basic multi-layer perceptron in a pure code environment utilizing activation functions like ReLU, Sigmoid, etc.

cond_0258.intro:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team.
The Data Scientist position within the [Company name masked] Aftermarket Analytics team in Customer Service is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing solutions that support strategic initiatives by generating actionable insights and recommendations based on the latest data science methodologies. This role will have a focus on forecasting aircraft maintenance to assist with annual operational planning, discounting strategy, creating long term maintenance agreements, and ensuring we keep our service centers full.
A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with business stakeholders, data professionals, and data consumers across the organization to share findings and move analytical work forward.
cond_0258.responsibilities:
Build, optimize, and automate data models to support business reporting and ad-hoc analysis
Actively advise leadership on analytical, data-driven approaches to solve challenges and identify opportunities
Develop statistical and machine learning models to answer business questions and make predictions using R, Python, and other programming languages
Experiment and explore new technologies to support business objectives
Monitor data models for accuracy and performance and update as needed to maintain quality
Develop best practices and document proven solutions
Connect regularly with other data professionals throughout the organization to embrace cross functional growth in analytics capabilities
Provide guidance to data analysts to support expanding descriptive models into a predictive or prescriptive environment
Conduct training on data literacy and data science capabilities to data consumers
Gather and document analytics project requirements from business stakeholders, initiating discussions to clarify needs and identify opportunities to apply advanced analytic approaches
Explore and understand the inner workings and market context of an aircraft OEM
Preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment
Solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques
Evaluate and optimize the performance of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
cond_0258.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or Computer Science plus 2 years relevant technical experience, or bachelor's degree in a related field plus 4 years relevant technical experience
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information clearly to a broad audience
Practical application experience with one or more analytics packages such as SAS, R, SQL, Python (and associated libraries), or similar
Experience working with relational databases, APIs, and ML production environments
Advanced analytics skills, including statistical characterization of large sets, regression modeling, probability distribution fitting, stochastic simulation, and multivariate sensitivity analysis
Demonstrated ability to clean and prepare data using techniques such as compression, binning, normalization/scaling, and 1-hot encoding within a pure code environment (Notebook or IDE)
Advanced matrix, multidimensional array, and table operations in pure coding environment
Demonstrated ability to preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reduction algorithms within a pure code environment, including decision tree analysis, boosting, or Principal Component Analysis
Technical ability to solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques including SVM, logistic regression, and clustering
Technical ability to evaluate (e.g., F1 Score, Confusion Matrices, RMSE) and optimize the performance (e.g., grid search, hyperparameter tuning) of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
Preferred Requirements
Aviation experience
Experience with Microsoft Office including Excel and PowerPoint
Ability to identify relevant metrics and walk stakeholders through technical findings comfortably
Desire and ability to learn and leverage new software, tools, and processes in a self-learning environment
Basic understanding of time-series data analysis and prediction modeling (ARIMA, SARIMA, exponential smoothing) or similar
Basic understanding of Neural Networks with the ability to train a basic multi-layer perceptron in a pure code environment utilizing activation functions like ReLU, Sigmoid, etc.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

cond_0383.intro:
Data Scientists support business growth by using business intelligence software, advanced data mining techniques, and statistical analysis methodology to automate complex processes, visualize large data sets, and generate new insights.
The Data Scientist position within the [Company name masked] Aftermarket Analytics team in Customer Service is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing solutions that support strategic initiatives by generating actionable insights and recommendations based on the latest data science methodologies. This role will have a focus on forecasting aircraft maintenance to assist with annual operational planning, discounting strategy, creating long term maintenance agreements, and ensuring we keep our service centers full. Most people become stronger in this kind of data science and modeling work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0383.responsibilities:
Build, optimize, and automate data models to support business reporting and ad-hoc analysis
Advise leadership on analytical, data-driven approaches to solve challenges and identify opportunities
Develop statistical and machine learning models to answer business questions and make predictions using R, Python, and other programming languages
Experiment and explore new technologies to support business objectives
Monitor data models for accuracy and performance and update as needed to maintain quality
Develop best practices and document proven solutions
Interface with other data professionals throughout the organization to embrace cross functional growth in analytics capabilities
Provide guidance to data analysts to support expanding descriptive models into a predictive or prescriptive environment
Conduct training on data literacy and data science capabilities to data consumers
Gather and document analytics project requirements from business stakeholders, identifying opportunities to apply advanced analytic approaches
Explore and understand the inner workings and market context of an aircraft OEM
Preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment.
Solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques
Evaluate and optimize the performance of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
cond_0383.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or Computer Science plus 2 years relevant technical experience, or bachelor's degree in a related field plus 4 years relevant technical experience
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience with Microsoft Office including Excel and PowerPoint
Practical application experience with one or more analytics packages such as SAS, R, SQL, Python (& associated libraries), or similar
Experience working with relational databases, APIs, and ML production environments
Advanced analytics skills, including statistical characterization of large sets, regression modeling, probability distribution fitting, stochastic simulation, and multivariate sensitivity analysis
Ability to identify relevant metrics and explain technical information to a broad audience
Desire and ability to learn and leverage new software, tools, and processes in a self-learning environment
Demonstrated ability to clean and prepare data using techniques such as compression, binning, normalization/scaling, and 1-hot encoding within a pure code environment (Notebook or IDE)
Advanced matrix, multidimensional array, and table operations in pure coding environment
Demonstrated ability to preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment, including decision tree analysis, boosting, or Principal Component Analysis
Technical ability to solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques including SVM, logistic regression, and clustering
Technical ability to evaluate (i.e., F1 Score, Confusion Matrices, RMSE, etc.) and optimize the performance (i.e., grid search, hyperparameter tuning) of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
Preferred Requirements
Aviation experience
Basic understanding of time-series data analysis and prediction modeling (ARIMA, SARIMA, exponential smoothing) or otherwise
Basic understanding of Neural Networks with the ability to train a basic multi-layer perceptron in a pure code environment utilizing activation functions like ReLU, Sigmoid, etc.

Data Scientists support business growth by using business intelligence software, advanced data mining techniques, and statistical analysis methodology to automate complex processes, visualize large data sets, and generate new insights. Data scientists are highly analytical, technically skilled, and have a passion for sharing their insights to a broad audience.
The Data Scientist position within the [Company name masked] Aftermarket Analytics team in Customer Service is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing solutions that support strategic initiatives by generating actionable insights and recommendations based on the latest data science methodologies. This role will have a focus on forecasting aircraft maintenance to assist with annual operational planning, discounting strategy, creating long term maintenance agreements, and ensuring we keep our service centers full.
cond_0434.responsibilities:
Build, optimize, and automate data models to support business reporting and ad-hoc analysis
Advise leadership on analytical, data-driven approaches to solve challenges and identify opportunities
Develop statistical and machine learning models to answer business questions and make predictions using R, Python, and other programming languages
Experiment and explore new technologies to support business objectives
Monitor data models for accuracy and performance and update as needed to maintain quality
Develop best practices and document proven solutions
Interface with other data professionals throughout the organization to embrace cross functional growth in analytics capabilities
Provide guidance to data analysts to support expanding descriptive models into a predictive or prescriptive environment
Conduct training on data literacy and data science capabilities to data consumers
Gather and document analytics project requirements from business stakeholders, identifying opportunities to apply advanced analytic approaches
Explore and understand the inner workings and market context of an aircraft OEM
Preprocess data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reductions algorithms within a pure code environment.
Solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques
Evaluate and optimize the performance of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
cond_0434.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree required in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or Computer Science; advanced degree strongly preferred
Minimum 4 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant technical field (or 2 years with a directly related degree)
Deep knowledge of one or more analytics packages such as SAS, R, SQL, Python (and associated libraries), or similar
Proven track record working with relational databases, APIs, and ML production environments
Advanced analytics expertise, including statistical characterization of large datasets, regression modeling, probability distribution fitting, stochastic simulation, and multivariate sensitivity analysis
Demonstrated expertise in cleaning and preparing data using techniques such as compression, binning, normalization/scaling, and 1-hot encoding within a pure code environment (Notebook or IDE)
Strong command of matrix, multidimensional array, and table operations in a pure coding environment
Demonstrated expertise in preprocessing data using feature selection and/or dimensionality reduction algorithms within a pure code environment, including decision tree analysis, boosting, or Principal Component Analysis
Proven ability to solve regression and classification problems using established machine learning techniques including SVM, logistic regression, and clustering
Proven ability to evaluate (e.g., F1 Score, Confusion Matrices, RMSE) and optimize the performance (e.g., grid search, hyperparameter tuning) of machine learning models through results-based training and testing
Preferred Requirements
Aviation experience
Solid understanding of time-series data analysis and prediction modeling (ARIMA, SARIMA, exponential smoothing) or similar
Solid understanding of Neural Networks with the ability to train a multi-layer perceptron in a pure code environment utilizing activation functions such as ReLU, Sigmoid, etc.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly to a broad audience
Strong command of Microsoft Office including Excel and PowerPoint
Ability to identify relevant metrics and translate complex findings for non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new software, tools, and processes independently
